items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: I think it was an Italian guy who used to arrange for Benny Goodman. And they invited that guy to their house... And he gave them all copies of Benny Goodman's arrangements.

ctx.x: Did you play with many big bands through the years?

The best reading band I ever played with Dick was Angelo Quackalina's Blue Party. They had three brothers, Angelo, Phillip, and Joe. And he, they made friends with the, I think it was an Italian guy who used to arrange for Benny Goodman. And they invited that guy to their house and gave him spaghetti and meatball, pasta basura, whatever you call it. And he gave them all copies of Benny Goodman's arrangements. And boy, those things were written in seven flats, seven shelves, all odd keys. And Angelo says, I know…
